text: The Debian landing adds app and language-pack templates with install, links, distribution and debhelper rules. Current control templates use ${PKG_NAME}, ${ARCH_NAME}, ${DEPENDS} and ${DESCRIPTION}. The app install template adds a .desktop entry, while the language-pack install template only installs its Thunderbird files. The app links template gives the binary a package-specific command name but keeps org.mozilla.Thunderbird icon filenames. Manual template naming proposal for this family: preserve .in inputs, exact uppercase substitution names and external icon identity separately from generated package names. These current placeholders differ from some original DEB_ spellings. The template contents are retained, while the old release-deb-repackage task kind is absent. No built Debian package was validated.
title: Debian template values are packaging contracts rather than JavaScript names
